Level 13 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Vast
Hirelings: 2
Order: Recruit

Enclosures large enough for up to four Large creatures; four Small or Medium creatures can share the space of one Large creature.

Recruit: Creature. The hirelings add a creature from the Menagerie Creatures table to your Menagerie in 7 days, for the listed cost, and look after it.

Creatures in your Menagerie count as Bastion Defenders; remove those you lose from your roster. You can choose not to count some of them as defenders, in which case they can't be called on to defend the Bastion and act according to their nature, using their Monster Manual stat blocks.
